validation.mode: Offline owned loopback fixtures in fresh profiles behind a deny proxy
unitRegressions: Edge native permission denial: reproduced before fix; disabling remains available afterward
Wildcard-heavy URL scope: reproduced one-second VM timeout before replacing regex backtracking
browserCoverage: Per-script GM values and denied administrative messages
Import/export, stale drafts, discard, deletion, Escape cancellation
Literal metadata display and long-name layout

limitations: Documented subset of Violentmonkey features; no remote dependencies, automatic script updates or privileged network API.
Firefox automation rejected extension-page navigation before assertions. No Firefox runtime pass is claimed.
Extension-update restoration is unit tested. Native worker restart is browser tested; a full reload of the CDP-loaded test extension hit Chrome OFFSTORE protection, which was not bypassed.
Offline tests do not establish coverage against every live site. Reload the unpacked extension to use these source changes.
harnessCorrections: Edge details page is reopened for each native permission change; reusing its old page changed the visible switch without applying revocation.
Native controls are activated, scrolled instantly, and hit-tested after layout before input; dialogs must be visible. Explicit pressed-button state corrected Edge input that had not produced a click.
One Edge startup encountered a locked DevToolsActivePort file and was retried; retained as a failed attempt.
